title: Bamboo Unpack
description: Lets you cut Bamboo Blocks into Bamboo using a stonecutter. Simple and survival-friendly.
body:
Adds a stonecutter recipe to convert Bamboo Blocks back into Bamboo, making bamboo farming and storage more efficient. Great for builders and survival players.
